verdicts.reason: A leaves the white line-frame empty over the photo and dumps all the text below it in the wrong order: tickets info comes before 'Richmond High School Theatre Presents', and the credit comes last. The play icon is blown up and jammed into the bottom-left corner, and the orange tint covers only part of the photo. B keeps the original reading order (presenter, title with credit and play icon inside the frame, tickets) and stays readable, but the orange tint is cut down to a mid band so the rest of the photo is untinted. The frame is cramped around 'Pygmalion' and the text above and below floats loosely on the photo, so it still needs polish.
